coverTitle:
Five Prayers
For The Love
That Didn't Stay
coverDek: For the breakup you're still carrying, the betrayal that blindsided you, and proof that your heart can actually heal — not just learn to look fine.

points.hook: Lord, I didn't know a person could leave and take half my future plans with them.
paragraphs: Father, I'm not just grieving a person tonight — I'm grieving the version of my life I built around them: the trip we never took, the home I pictured, the years I quietly assumed were already spoken for. I need You to meet me in the specific grief, not just the general sadness, because this ache isn't abstract — it has a name, a face, a last conversation I keep replaying on a loop. Bind up what's actually broken in me, Lord, not just what everyone else can see.
points.verseText: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

points.hook: I declare tonight: what left me did not leave me unfinished — it left me available!
paragraphs: I am done begging a closed door to reopen. In the name of Jesus, I release every claim they still think they have on my peace, my future, and my next season — that chapter is sealed! What God has for me does not require their return, their apology, or their understanding. I declare my heart is not a casualty, it is a construction site, and the Builder is already on the job. Every tie that was never blessed, I cut it now — and every door that was never opened by God, I let stay shut!
points.verseText: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it?

points.hook: My chest still physically hurts when their name comes up, and I need You in that too.
paragraphs: Father, grief isn't just in my head — it's in my shoulders, my stomach, the shallow breath I take every time I see something that reminds me of them. I'm not asking You to rush the hollow feeling or shame me for still flinching at a song, a street, a smell. I'm asking You to sit in the actual body that's carrying this with me — steady my breathing when the memory hits sideways, loosen what's clenched, and let healing move through me as slowly as it needs to, not as fast as I want to perform it.
points.verseText: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

points.hook: Church, somebody in this room is smiling in service and falling apart in the car afterward over a love that didn't stay.
paragraphs: We're not going to let you carry this quietly just because it feels embarrassing to still be sad about someone who clearly isn't sad about you. We see you, we're praying with you, and we're not going to rush you to "get over it" on our timeline. Lord, surround every heartbroken person reading this with real people, not just a verse and a closed door — give them someone to call at eleven at night, someone to sit across the table they used to share with somebody else. Let Your Church be the family that stays when a relationship doesn't.
points.verseText: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and good works: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together... but exhorting one another.

points.hook: Baby, come here. Let Me hold what they couldn't.
paragraphs: I know you gave pieces of yourself to someone who didn't stay long enough to deserve them, and I know part of you is scared that means there's less of you than there used to be. There isn't. Nothing you gave was wasted on Me — I collect every tear in a bottle, I know the exact shape of this particular sorrow, and I promise you the love that's coming for you later won't have to compete with a ghost, because I'm healing you all the way, not just enough to function. Rest in My arms tonight. I've got you.
points.verseText: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

cta.closingLine: If this spoke to you, let's stay connected.
